Evan Mobley scored the Cavaliers' first basket more than anyone in 2025-26: 26 times in 81 starts, or 32% of the games they started. Jarrett Allen was next with 19. The Cavaliers made the game's first field goal in 61% of their 100 games and won 66% of their opening tipoffs. Everything below is counted from the play-by-play of every 2025-26 game (1,225 regular season, 85 playoffs, 6 play-in).
